reason: Visualiseert dat vocht in muren meerdere oorzaken kan hebben en ondersteunt de diagnostische logica van de pagina.
prompt: Editorial diagnostic diagram for a Dutch home renovation guide about moisture in walls. Show a simplified exterior wall and adjacent interior with multiple independent possible moisture sources: driving rain at facade, leaking pipe, indoor condensation, moisture near ground level, and failed joint or opening. Use abstract arrows and icons, no embedded words, no repair instructions, no claim that any one source is the cause. Cream background, dark mineral green, warm terracotta highlights, clean architectural infographic style, no logo, no watermark.
alt: Schema met meerdere mogelijke oorzaken van vocht in muren
